text:
Hi there, and thank you for contacting Leafy! 🌿 Congratulations on your new snake plant.

I'm sorry to say that I can't offer the price difference this time. Our price drop adjustment covers items that go down in price within **7 days** of purchase, and you're well within that window at 5 days. But it **doesn't apply to flash sales or clearance prices**, and since the lower price is from a flash sale, it isn't eligible.

If you feel strongly that an exception should be made, just let me know and I'll escalate your request to a Support Lead. I can't promise the outcome, but they can review it.

Is there anything else I can help with? Our Plant Care Specialists are also happy to give free care tips for your snake plant by chat (9am-5pm Mon-Fri) or email. Please reach out any time! 🌱
